_note: Every value here is a heuristic, not a clinical grade. YouCam raw_score runs 1 to 100 where higher is healthier. These are provisional until calibrated against the saved scan bank, and the Methods page says so. The UI shows the actual raw_score next to any verdict one of these triggered.
_status: provisional, calibrated against 1 of 8 scan fixtures

ACNE_ASK_T.meaning: Below this acne raw_score, ask the shopper about deep painful bumps and scarring. The score never asserts that acne is present.

REDNESS_T.meaning: Below this redness raw_score, treat the skin as reactive: barrier first, no stacking.

WRINKLE_HEALTHY_T.meaning: At or above this wrinkle raw_score, an anti-aging product has nothing visible to work on yet.

HIGH_ACID_PCT.meaning: Leave-on acid percentage at or above which an at-home product is treated as a peel-strength risk. Overridable by the HIGH_ACID_PCT env var.

healthy_by_concern._meaning: Used by R-NEED-02. At or above these raw_scores, a product aimed at that concern has nothing to work on.

skin_type_contradictions._meaning: Used by R-NEED-02. A product tagged this way contradicts a scan that reports this skin type.
